lines.speaker: cultist_pilgrim
lines.text: The pilgrimage is complete. You kept your word, traveller. The Choir keeps its debts as well.

lines.speaker: cultist_pilgrim
lines.text: Of course. And should the Choir need a careful captain again, someone may find you.

lines.speaker: cultist_pilgrim
lines.text: Travel quietly, courier. We may speak again.
